others.route: Permiso de trabajo y permiso de residencia

note: Equatorial Guinea: a visa is needed to enter, a stay beyond it needs a 'permanencia' (a visa extension of usually three months) from the police, and to live in the country a foreigner must obtain a work permit and a residence permit, both slow and costly, with a visa again to enter and leave (Embassy of Spain in Malabo, Trabajar en Guinea Ecuatorial). Read from the Spanish embassy's guide, as Morocco's file reads the Spanish consulate's; the Ministry of Labour's own text and the law weren't reached (the Boletín Oficial's site doesn't answer this client). The issuing ministry, any performers' route and any days without the permits aren't named, so none are modelled.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Malabo, Trabajar en Guinea Ecuatorial
sources.said: Para residir en Guinea Ecuatorial, es necesario, asimismo, obtener un permiso de trabajo y un permiso de residencia. Ambos trámites pueden resultar lentos y costosos.
